scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names API,WEB "uv run --project backend uvicorn backend.app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000" "npm --prefix frontend run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173 --strictPort"
scripts.lint: node scripts/check-feeds.mjs && uv run --project backend ruff check backend && uv run --project backend ruff format --check backend && uv run --project backend mypy -p backend.app && npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run format:check
scripts.test: uv run --project backend pytest backend/tests && python -m unittest discover -s infra/tests -v && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.setup: uv sync --project backend --locked && npm --prefix frontend ci
